description_full: Resona Holdings, Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the provision retail and commercial banking products and services in Japan and internationally. The company operates Individual, Corporate, and market segment. It provides consulting services, that includes personal loan, asset management, and asset succession services to individuals; and corporate lending, asset management using trusts, real estate operations, corporate pensions, and business succession services to corporates. The company is also involved in financial market services, that includes short term lending, borrowing, purchase and sale of bonds, and derivatives trading. Resona Holdings, Inc. was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

financial_summary: Resona Holdings, Inc. is a large-cap financial services business with a $30.5B market cap on $6.5B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +7% over the past three years, a respectable pace for a business of this size.
The company is burning through $30.1B of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year.

Shareholder yield of 2.6% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome.
